nymBinary.description: nym executable. Default: nym on PATH, else the newest local build under $XDG_DATA_HOME/nym/builds.

profiles.description: nym redaction profiles added to `default` (see `nym profiles`).

ner.description: Run nym's local NER model for names and addresses.

nerScope.description: Which strings NER runs on (see `nym traces anon --help`).

defaultBackup.description: Preselected choice for the original session.

kyzService.description: kyz service holding the backup passphrase.

kyzKey.description: kyz key holding the backup passphrase (created on first use).

guard.description: When switching to a non-local model with unredacted content: confirm before the next prompt, only warn, or nothing.

localProviders.description: Providers (case-insensitive) that never trigger the guard.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time for one nym run.
